scope: Bilingual Elixir and Erlang concept dependencies from getBasicPaths; pending human confirmation.

semantics.nodes: Merge exact canonical core_concept IDs across locales and languages; retain the first lesson and all core introductions in each context. Cross-language equivalence still requires confirmation.
semantics.reusedIn: Evidence records lesson-level reused_in declarations from each core introduction; they do not independently prove that every co-introduced concept is reused.
semantics.prerequisite: Each declared prerequisite points to each core concept of that lesson. Repeated concept pairs share one edge with all locale/language evidence retained.
semantics.contrast: Only declared related lesson links produce candidate contrast edges, from the source core concepts to the related lesson core concepts. No reverse or inferred links are added; empty related arrays produce no edges.
semantics.contributions: One project-application record per localized lesson, with its exact project_contribution and core concepts. No project name is inferred.
semantics.depthPages: Preserve declared paths alongside locale-prefixed URLs, including the start-iex installation guide.
